instruction.text: Listen to the stories below. Choose the story that matches the addition problem.

b.sound: Antonio slept for 8 hours. Jason slept 2 more hours than Antonio. How many hours did Jason sleep?
Antonio slept for 9 hours. Jason slept 3 hours fewer than Antonio. How many hours did Jason sleep?

instruction.text: Listen to the stories below. Choose the story that matches the subtraction problem.

b.sound: Chloe and Chun baked a cake with 15 slices. Chloe took 6 slices home with her. How many slices are left for Chun?
Chloe and Chun baked a cake with 10 slices. Chloe didn’t take any slices home with her. How many slices are left for Chun?

atoms.b: There are ((9)) slices left for Chun.
